tagline: One day i'd fly for sure
journal:
I've always had an obsession with aircraft, I think it all started back when I was a child. I remember dad once taking me to an air show over the Easter holidays. I remember him pointing out to me a Harrier jump jet, I said I didn't know what that was and I remember he took great joy in explaining to me how it could take off vertically unlike a normal aircraft.

For the rest of the Easter break all I wanted to do was make one of my own, and sure enough,  with dad's help, we got something that could just about fly. It was no jump jet, but it was good enough for me. We took it down past the allotments and onto the open grassy field, I used to chase after it for what felt like forever and told myself that one day i'd be a pilot.

After dad passed away I found that old model again when I was clearing out the house, he'd kept it stuffed at the top of the wardrobe all these years, wing still half bent from the landing.

music.why: A boy chasing a homemade glider across an open field at sunset, remembered fondly after his dad's passing, calls for warm, bittersweet looking-back.
